name: stubyard
description: Fake email, SMS, WhatsApp, payment, storage and login providers for local testing, in one container

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w @stubyard/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w @stubyard/client && npm run typecheck -w @stubyard/extension
